stem: In the \(xy\)-plane, the graph of \(ax + 6y = 18\), where \(a\) is a constant, has an \(x\)-intercept whose \(x\)-coordinate is 3 times the \(y\)-coordinate of its \(y\)-intercept. What is the value of \(a\)?
solution: So the \(x\)-intercept is at \(x = 3 \cdot 3 = 9\), the point \((9, 0)\).
verify:
a, x, y = symbols('a x y')
yi = solve(Eq(6*y, 18), y)[0]
xi = solve(Eq(a*x, 18), x)[0]
sol = solve(Eq(xi, 3*yi), a)
assert sol == [2]
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == sol
